items.title: The space of connected components of a quasi-compact space whose components are intersections of clopens is profinite
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that the space of connected components of a quasi-compact space, each component being the intersection of the clopens containing it, is profinite (author lemma at source lines 4448-4454, label lemma-pi0-profinite). The proof (source lines 4456-4476) checks quasi-compactness and total disconnectedness and obtains Hausdorffness by separating two components with a single clopen produced from the finite intersection criterion (proof lines 4456-4475). The separation by a clopen is the substance. H3.
